subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should the experimental core Claw lifecycle own automatic ClawHub package installation and persisted shared-artifact ownership under RFC 27, including a temporarily plugin-only preflight path?
rationale: The implementation establishes new core lifecycle, persistence, consent, and third-party package-execution contracts across a still-open stacked RFC; code review cannot decide whether that permanent product boundary is desired.

options.title: Finish the gated stack
options.body: Keep this PR draft, fix the state-environment defect, add exact-head live proof, and approve landing only after the RFC and prerequisite stack are accepted.

options.title: Narrow to plugins
options.body: Accept only the plugin package-owner path and remove or clearly defer unreachable skill installation behavior until a read-only skill preflight exists.

options.title: Pause package ownership
options.body: Leave package actions blocked and postpone this slice if maintainers do not want core Claw lifecycle to own shared ClawHub artifact installation and provenance.

recommendation.title: Finish the gated stack
recommendation.body: Keep this PR draft, fix the state-environment defect, add exact-head live proof, and approve landing only after the RFC and prerequisite stack are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is assigned and has already reviewed the exact ownership, trust, removal, and RFC contract decisions at issue.
